# Data Preparation

## Install and Load Required Packages

```{r install-packages, eval=FALSE}
install.packages(c("sf", "dplyr", "terra", "spatstat", "ggplot2", "raster",
"dismo", "ENMeval", "ecospat", "reshape2", "tidyr")
```{r load-libraries}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(terra)
library(ggplot2)
```
## Process Florida County Shapefiles

```{r county-processing}
counties <- st_read("/INSERT/FILE/HERE")
county_centroids <- st_centroid(counties)
county_centroids <- st_transform(county_centroids, 4326)
county_centroids <- county_centroids %>%
mutate(
longitude = 26 latitude = st_coordinates(. .)[,1],
st_coordinates(. .)[,2]
)
county_df <- st_drop_geometry(county_centroids)
head(county_df)
```
## West Nile Virus Data Processing

```{r wnv-data}
wnv_data <- read.csv(file.choose()
wnv_data$ $CountyName <- sub("FL, ",
""
, wnv_data$ $FullGeoName)
wnv_data$ $CountyName[wnv_data$ $CountyName = "De Soto"] <- "DeSoto"
wnv_with_coords <- wnv_data %>%
left_join(county_df %>% select(NAME, longitude, latitude),
by = c("CountyName" = "NAME")
sum(is.na(wnv_with_coords$ $longitude)
write.csv(wnv_with_coords, "/INSERT/FILE/HERE", row.names
= FALSE)
```
## Calculate Total Cases

```{r total-cases}
wnv_with_coords <- wnv_with_coords %>%
mutate(total_cases = Reported.human.cases + Neuroinvasive.disease.cases
+ Identified.by.Blood.Donor.Screening)

filter(total_cases > 0) %>%
mutate(species = "WNV") %>%
select(species, longitude, latitude, total_cases)

= FALSE)

# Spatial Point Generation

## Generate Weighted Random Points for WNV

```{r weighted r weighted-
-points}
counties_sf <- st_read(file.choose()
counties_with_cases <- counties_sf %>%
left_join(wnv_with_coords %>%
select(CountyName, total_cases),
by = c("NAME" = "CountyName")
counties_with_cases <- counties_with_cases %>%
filter(total_cases > 0)
set.seed(123)
wnv_points_list <- list()
for(i in 1::nrow(counties_with_cases) {
county_geom <- counties_with_cases[i,]
n_points <- counties_with_cases$ $total_cases[i]
points <- st_sample(county_geom, size = n_points, type = "random")
wnv_points_list[i] <- points
}
wnv_points <- do.call(c, wnv_points_list)
wnv_coords <- st_coordinates(wnv_points) %>%
as.data.frame() %>%
rename(longitude = X, latitude = Y) %>%
mutate(species = "WNV")
head(wnv_coords)
nrow(wnv_coords)
write.csv(wnv_coords, "/INSERT/FILE/HERE", row.names = FALSE)
```
# Raster Processing

## Agriculture Raster Alignment

```{r agriculture r agriculture-
-raster}
ag_raster <- rast(file.choose()
template <- rast(file.choose()
ag_lowres <- aggregate(ag_raster, fact=150, fun="modal")
ag_reprojected <- project(ag_lowres, crs(template)
ag_cropped <- crop(ag_reprojected, template)
ag_resampled <- resample(ag_cropped, template, method = "mode")
print("Template resolution:")
res(template)
print("Resampled agriculture resolution:")
res(ag_resampled)
writeRaster(ag_resampled, "/INSERT/FILE/HERE", overwrite=TR
UE)
test_stack <- c(template, ag_resampled)
print("Stack successful - layers perfectly aligned!")
nlyr(test_stack)
```
# Spatial Statistics

## Clark-Evans Test for Spatial Clustering

```{r clustering r clustering-
-analysis}
library(spatstat)
data <- read.csv(file.choose()
window <- owin(range(data$ $longitude), range(data$ $latitude)
ppp_data <- ppp(data$ $longitude, data$ $latitude, window=window)
ce_test <- clarkevans.test(ppp_data)
print(ce_test)
```
## Visualization of Spatial Clustering

```{r clustering r clustering-
-plot, fig.cap="WNV Spatial Clustering Analysis"}

# Data Cleaning

## Filter Points Within Raster Extent

```{r filter r filter-
-points}
library(raster)
raster_file <- file.choose()
r <- raster(raster_file)
csv_file <- file.choose()
points <- read.csv(csv_file)
coords <- points[, c("longitude", "latitude")]
sp_points <- SpatialPoints(coords, proj4string = crs(r)
vals <- raster::::extract(r, sp_points)
points$ $inside_raster <- !is.na(vals)
clean_points <- points %>% filter(inside_raster)
save_file <- file.choose(new = TRUE)
write.csv(clean_points, save_file, row.names = FALSE)
```

# Sampling Bias Layer

## Create Bias Layer for MaxEnt

```{r bias r bias-
-layer}
occs <- read.csv(file.choose()
template <- rast(file.choose()
coords <- vect(occs, geom = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = "EPSG:4326")
coords <- project(coords, template)
bias <- rasterize(coords, template, fun = "length", background = 0)
bias <- bias + 1
bias <- focal(bias, w = 7, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
```{r bias r bias-
-plot, fig.cap="Sampling Bias Layer"}
plot(bias, main = "Sampling Bias Layer")
points(coords, pch = 20, col = "red", cex = 0.5)
output_path <- file.choose(new = TRUE)
writeRaster(bias, output_path,
filetype = "AAIGrid",
overwrite = TRUE,
NAflag = -
-9999)
```
# MaxEnt Modeling

## ENMeval Model Tuning and Selection

```{r enmeval r enmeval, eval=FALSE}
library(dismo)
library(ENMeval)
occs <- read.csv(file.choose()
occs_coords <- occs[, c("longitude", "latitude")]
colnames(occs_coords) <- c("lon", "lat")
occs_coords <- na.omit(occs_coords)
env_folder <- "/INSERT/FILE/HERE"
env_files <- list.files(env_folder, pattern = "\.asc$", full.names = TRUE)
env_rast <- rast(env_files)
bias_rast <- rast(file.choose()
bias_values <- values(bias_rast)
bias_values[is.na(bias_values)] <- 0
set.seed(123)
bg_cells <- sample(1::ncell(bias_rast), size = 10000, prob = bias_values, re
place = FALSE)
bg_coords <- xyFromCell(bias_rast, bg_cells)
colnames(bg_coords) <- c("lon", "lat")
valid_occ_idx <- which(!is.na(extract(env_rast[1], occs_coords)
occs_valid <- occs_coords[valid_occ_idx,]
valid_bg_idx <- which(!is.na(extract(env_rast[1], bg_coords)
bg_coords_valid <- bg_coords[valid_bg_idx,]
eval_results <- ENMevaluate(
occs = occs_valid,
envs = env_rast,
bg = bg_coords_valid,
tune.args = list(fc = c("L", "LQ", "LQH", "LQHP"), rm = seq(0.5, 3, 0. 0.
),
partitions = "block",
algorithm = "maxent.jar",
parallel = FALSE
)
results_table <- eval_results@ @results
write.csv(results_table, "/INSERT/FILE/HERE", row.na
mes = FALSE)
best_idx <- which.min(results_table$ $AICc)
best_model <- results_table[best_idx,]
best_pred <- eval.predictions(eval_results)[best_idx]
writeRaster(best_pred, "/INSERT/FILE/HERE", overwrite = TRUE)
f" f", overwrite = TRUE)
plot(best_pred)
```

/5, 1/3,

), nrow = 11, byrow = TRUE)
rownames(jev_pairwise) <- criteria
colnames(jev_pairwise) <- criteria
calculate_ahp_weights <- function(matrix) {
col_sums <- colSums(matrix)
normalized_matrix <- sweep(matrix, 2, col_sums, FUN = "/")
weights <- rowMeans(normalized_matrix)
return(weights)
}
jev_weights <- calculate_ahp_weights(jev_pairwise)
print("JEV AHP Weights:")
print(round(jev_weights, 4)
```
## AHP Consistency Ratio

```{r ahp r ahp-
-consistency}
calculate_consistency_ratio <- function(matrix, weights) {
n <- nrow(matrix)
weighted_sum <- matrix %*%*% weights
lambda_max <- mean(weighted_sum / weights)
CI <- (lambda_max -
- n) / (n -
- 1)
RI_values <- c(0, 0, 0.58, 0.90, 1.12, 1.24, 1.32, 1.41, 1.45, 1.49, 1. 1.
, 1.54)
RI <- RI_values[n]
CR <- CI / RI
return(list(lambda_max = lambda_max, CI = CI, CR = CR)
}
consistency <- calculate_consistency_ratio(jev_pairwise, jev_weights)
print(paste("Consistency Ratio:", round(consistency$ $CR, 4)
```

# Niche Overlap Analysis

## Calculate Niche Overlap Metrics

```{r niche r niche-
-overlap}
wnv <- rast(file.choose()
jev <- rast(file.choose()
jev <- resample(jev, wnv, method="bilinear")
norm <- function(x) {
r <- minmax(x)
(x -
- r[1]) / (r[2] -
- r[1])
}
wnv_n <- norm(wnv)
jev_n <- norm(jev)
overlap_metrics <- function(a, b){
pa <- values(a);; pb <- values(b)
ok <- complete.cases(pa, pb)
pa <- pa[ok];; pb <- pb[ok]
if(sum(pa)=0 || sum(pb)=0) return(c(D=NA, I=NA, Bh=NA)
pa <- pa / sum(pa)
pb <- pb / sum(pb)
D <- 1 -
- 0.5 * sum(abs(pa -
- pb)
I <- sum(sqrt(pa * pb)
Bh <- -
-log(sum(sqrt(pa * pb)
return(c(D=D, I=I, Bh=Bh)
}
obs <- overlap_metrics(wnv_n, jev_n)
```
## Permutation Test for Significance

```{r permutation r permutation-
-test}
set.seed(123)
n_perm <- 1000
perm_vals <- matrix(NA, n_perm, 3)
colnames(perm_vals) <- c("D","I","Bh")
for(i in 1::n_perm){
perm_vals_vec <- sample(values(jev_n)
jev_perm <- setValues(jev_n, perm_vals_vec)
perm_vals[i,] <- overlap_metrics(wnv_n, jev_perm)
}
p_D <- mean(perm_vals[,"D"] >= obs["D"], na.rm=TRUE)
p_I <- mean(perm_vals[,"I"] >= obs["I"], na.rm=TRUE)
p_Bh <- mean(perm_vals[,"Bh"] <= obs["Bh"], na.rm=TRUE)
cat("Schoener's D:", round(obs["D"], 3), "\n")
cat("Hellinger I:", round(obs["I"], 3), "\n")
cat("Bhattacharyya Distance:", round(obs["Bh"], 3), "\n")
cat("p(D):", round(p_D, 4), "\n")
cat("p(I):", round(p_I, 4), "\n")
cat("p(Bh):", round(p_Bh, 4), "\n")
```

labs(x="WNV suitability", y="JEV suitability",
title="Bivariate Niche Density: WNV vs JEV")
```
